name: thread_inject
author: jm33-ng
comment: Inject shellcode into a target process as a remote thread, running under the operator-selected token (--token <SID>) instead of stealing/adjusting one itself

parameters.name: payload
parameters.description: Shellcode payload filename to fetch via agent.fetch_file. Payloads should be placed under /tmp/emp3r0r/www.

parameters.name: checksum
parameters.description: SHA256 of the payload, used to verify integrity; won't check if empty
